ui.design_rationale: The request targets a no-results message on an existing ecommerce search screen, so retain its neutral, indigo-accented product-search presentation rather than redesigning it.

files.purpose: Show the existing search form and results unchanged, displaying the requested query-specific message only after a completed search returns no products.

verify.steps: Submit a query that matches no products and confirm that after searching finishes the page shows No products match followed by the submitted query in quotation marks, without changing loading or result-grid behavior.

build_log.last_action: Planned the isolated no-results message fix in the existing search page.

assumption: The existing SearchPage route, search_products service, and its loading and result-grid behavior remain intact; only the completed empty-results state needs a message.
